content: WEBrick is thread-per-connection and can serve SSE, but on Ruby >= 3.5 (and Homebrew rubies) webrick is no longer a bundled gem - it must be an explicit gemspec dependency. SSE pattern: respond 200 text/event-stream without Content-Length, write 'data: <line>\n\n' per event and flush; thread-per-connection is fine for a handful of local clients.
